Reality Show 'The Traitors 2' Announces 21 Contestants

The 21 contestants for the reality television show 'The Traitors 2' have been revealed. Notable participants include Munawar Faruqui, Rhea Chakraborty, Mallika Sherawat, and Shweta Tiwari. The show will feature these celebrities engaging in a game of deception and strategy.
